headline: 2007 order keeps certain federal advisory committees running and changes or cancels some earlier executive orders.
what_it_does: This executive order keeps certain existing federal advisory committees in operation. These are groups that give advice to the President or federal agencies. The order also changes some earlier executive orders and cancels others. The title does not say which committees or orders are involved.

who_it_affects.how: Committees covered by the order can keep meeting and giving advice instead of ending.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that support these committees
who_it_affects.how: Agencies keep running and staffing the committees that were continued.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 28, 2007; no specific start date is stated in the title.
